measureRecords.whatItDoes: Sets 4-year terms beginning with the November 2027 municipal election for Danbury’s mayor, town clerk, treasurer, City Council, Zoning Commission and its alternates, and constables. The Board of Education would elect 6 members to 4-year terms in November 2027 and 5 members to 2-year terms in November 2029. In November 2031 and every 4 years afterward, all 11 school-board members would be elected to 4-year terms.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the four-year municipal terms and the described school-board transition and election schedule.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed change to municipal and school-board terms.
